mute_off.docs: This action unmutes the output of the DAC.

id.docs:

*See also: [Audio DAC Core](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac#audio_dacmute_on-action)*

mute_on.docs: This action mutes the output of the DAC.

set_volume.docs: This action sets the output volume of the DAC.

aic3204.docs:
The `aic3204` platform allows your ESPHome devices to use the AIC3204 ultra low power stereo audio codec (DAC). This allows the playback of audio via the microcontroller from a range of sources via [Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/).

*See also: [AIC3204](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/aic3204)*

es8156.docs:
The `es8156` platform allows your ESPHome devices to use the ES8156 low power mono audio codec. This allows the playback of audio via the microcontroller from a range of sources via [Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) or [Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/).

*See also: [ES8156](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/es8156)*

es8311.docs:
The `es8311` platform allows your ESPHome devices to use the ES8311 low power mono audio codec. This allows the playback of audio via the microcontroller from a range of sources via [Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) or [Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/).

*See also: [ES8311](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/es8311)*

pcm5122.docs:
The `pcm5122` platform allows your ESPHome devices to use the PCM5122 high-performance stereo audio DAC. This allows the playback of audio via the microcontroller from a range of sources via [Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) or [Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/).

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122)*
